name: TopCell-ICP-Thermal Benchmark v0
description: Synthetic but physics-inspired upper Cell transient thermal benchmark for v6 code.

datasets.B_dynamic: 4 base conditions x 4 schedule types = 16 trajectories
datasets.D_pseudo_monitor: 2 pseudo-measurement logs with offset, drift, noise

truth_generator.equation: lumped RC network with plasma/heater/brine sources and first-order actuator lag
truth_generator.not_for_training: The learner only sees CSV trajectories and optional graph prior tables.
